info.name: 19 DPoP HI OPA \w ClientID Only
info.description:
## DPoP Human Identity (HI) — OPA Token Exchange with Client ID Only

This collection demonstrates a **DPoP (Demonstrating Proof of Possession)**-protected OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow for **Human Identity (HI)** use cases, using **Client ID Only** (public client, no client secret) authentication against an **Okta OPA (Okta Personal Access)** authorization server.

It covers the full end-to-end sequence from authorization through to obtaining an OPA vaulted token, with built-in handling for the server-issued **DPoP nonce** challenge.

---

### Flow Overview

The requests must be executed in order:

| # | Request | Purpose |
|---|---------|---------|
| 01 | **Authorize** | Initiates the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE (`S256`). Redirects the user to the Okta authorization server using the DPoP-bound client ID. |
| 02 | **Token** | Exchanges the authorization code for tokens. Sends an initial DPoP proof JWT (RS256, no nonce). Expects a `400` response containing a `dpop-nonce` header, which is captured for the next step. |
| 03 | **Token with DPoP Nonce** | Retries the token exchange with a new DPoP proof JWT that includes the server-issued nonce. On success, the resulting `id_token` is stored as the OPA subject token. |
| 04 | **Get OPA Vaulted Token** | Performs an OAuth 2.0 token exchange (`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`) to request an Okta vaulted secret token, using the subject token from step 03. Sends a fresh DPoP proof and expects a `400` with a new `dpop-nonce`. |
| 05 | **Get OPA Vaulted Token with DPoP Nonce** | Retries the OPA vaulted token exchange with a DPoP proof that includes the nonce from step 04. Returns the final vaulted token. |

---

### DPoP Proof Generation

Each request automatically generates a **DPoP proof JWT** in its pre-request script using the [`jsrsasign`](https://kjur.github.io/jsrsasign/) library (cached in globals for performance). An RSA 2048-bit key pair is generated once and stored in environment variables (`_dpop_privatekey`, `_dpop_pubkey`). Each proof is bound to the HTTP method and target URI, and includes a short 5-minute expiry.

---

### Key Variables

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `dpop_agent-cid-only-client_id` | The public client ID used throughout the flow |
| `agent-authZ-server-ID` | The Okta authorization server ID |
| `dpop-opa-cid-only-orn` | The OPA resource identifier (ORN) for the vaulted token request |
| `_dpop-cid-only-nonce` | DPoP nonce captured from the token endpoint (step 02) |
| `_dpop-opa-cid-only-nonce` | DPoP nonce captured from the OPA token exchange (step 04) |
| `_dpop-opa-cid-only-subject-token` | The `id_token` obtained in step 03, used as the subject token in steps 04–05 |
